goal: Собеседование в пятницу, боюсь вопросов про опыт

scenes.brief:
Situation: The learner is at a job interview on Friday and is most worried about questions about previous experience. This is the main part of the interview, where the interviewer asks about past work, skills, and basic responsibilities.
Learner: the learner is a job candidate. Partner: the partner is an interviewer.
Learner must be able to: say what job they had before; describe a few simple tasks they did; say what skills they have and what they can do; answer basic follow-up questions about experience at a beginner level.
Partner will: ask where the learner worked before and for how long; ask what tasks they had and what they can do; ask simple questions to clarify experience.
Not in this scene: greetings and introductions, talking about the company, discussing schedule, salary, next steps.

Situation: The learner arrives for a job interview on Friday and starts the conversation with the interviewer. This is the opening of the interview: greeting, introduction, confirming the position, and handling simple communication problems if a question is not understood.
Learner: the learner is a job candidate. Partner: the partner is an interviewer.
Learner must be able to: greet politely and introduce themselves; say which job they are applying for; respond to simple opening questions; ask the interviewer to repeat or speak more slowly.
Partner will: greet the learner and invite them to sit down; ask for the learner's name and the position; ask a simple opening question such as why they applied.
Not in this scene: detailed discussion of previous experience, describing job tasks, discussing salary, schedule, or final decisions.
